answers.core: Besides, there's also prior art of this with the InterpolatedCamera3D node in 3.x which not only interpolated FOV changes, but even Z near/far changes (although that aspect is probably not needed often).
answers.workaround:
This can be worked around by setting the FOV/zoom in `_process()` with the help of `Engine.get_physics_interpolation_fraction()` (by reading a member that is set in `_physics_process()`), but it's not trivial.

Considering this can make or break the appearance of physics interpolation in a game, it makes sense that this happens out of the box so users don't need to worry about it.

title: Interpolate camera FOV (3D) and zoom (2D) when using physics interpolation
